balls.text: four to finish the innings, and Stoinis has ransacked his way to 62 off 22! Low full toss outside off. Stoinis shuffles across and smears it through square leg. Perfect finish to what turned into another bruising PBKS innings, and they have made it past 220!
this is power, and this is Stoinis power! Another thunderous stroke, met with similarly thunderous applause. Full outside off. A touch short of the yorker and Stoinis bludgeons it over extra cover!

this is a juicy full toss, and Brijesh gets met! Full toss outside off and Stoinis climbs into it. Moves across his stumps and clubs it over cow corner. PBKS have reviewed it too, arguing it should be a No ball on height. Think this is a review in hope more than anything else. Stoinis' waist is measured at 1.09m, and the ball passed at 0.82m.
this is some shot! Not because Stoinis has middled this, but because of how he has still cleared the fence. Low full toss on the stumps and Stoinis somehow manages to biff it over wide long on!
gets this away! Zipped in full on middle and leg. Stoinis has a swipe at it and gets a thick inside edge that flies past short fine leg!
length ball hung up outside off and Stoinis cannot cash in. Swishes at it hard but onlt grabs a handful of fresh air
banged in short on middle and off. Gets a little big on Stoinis as he is backing away and he taps it into the off side
safe! Low full toss on the stumps. Shedge has a swing at it and clinks it on the bounce to long on. Wants the second but is sent back. Makes it in time
into the blockhole on off. Shedge hangs deep in his crease and dinks it into the mid wicket region. Ball barely crosses the ring and Shedge hares back for two
low full toss on middle and off. Stoinis cannot get under this and drills it all along the carpet to long off
do not bowl there either - Archer is travelling now! Right in the slot on the stumps. Stoinis cannot believe it and once he rubs his eyes in disbelief, he pumps it into the sightscreen!
do not bowl there to Marcus Stoinis! Leg-cutter but this is dragged down on off. Stoinis reads it like the morning daily and whacks it over deep mid wicket!

Shreyas' turn to find the moon, and Burger finally has some respite! Slower ball hung up on a length wide outside off. Shreyas tries to fight the angle and mow it over cow corner. The ball skews off the toe-end and Jurel, calling early, completes the catch in the short fine leg region. Shreyas departs after a scratchy innings, and RR keep chipping away!
nails the wide yorker this time. Stoinis jams down on it with an open bat face and digs it out towards deep backward point
slower bumper wide outside off. Stoinis jumps up onto his toes and slaps it over extra cover. Back for a couple of runs
muscled into the fence again! Another slot ball outside off. Stoinis does not middle this but gets enough on it to smear it between long on and deep mid wicket!
Stoinis on the charge now! Burger dishes out a freebie. Right in the slot outside off. Stoinis sits deep in his crease and launches it over long on!
slower ball bashed in short outside off. Shreyas is too early into the stroke and drags it towards backward square leg
low full toss on the pads. Shreyas squeezes it out towards deep mid wicket and retains strike
Shreyas breaks free! Back of a length outside off. Shreyas uses the pace on offer and muscles it past extra cover!
excellent yorker just outside off and this nearly crashes into Shreyas' stumps. He is late on the stroke and the ball sneaks just past off stump
slower bumper outside off. Shreyas thinks about swiping at it before bailing out of the stroke. Called one bouncer for the over
back of a length on middle and off. Stoinis pushes it into the point region and is content with a single
slower short ball outside off. Shreyas stands up on his toes and slaps it towards long off
Stoinis lands his first punch! This is a bit of a drag-down and like in the previous over, it gets punished. Stoinis sits deep in his crease and bashes it just beyond the wide long on fence!
back of a length on middle and leg. Straightens off the pitch and Stoinis plonks it back to the bowler
shortish outside off. Shreyas gets onto the back foot and powers it towards sweeper cover
slanted in full on leg. Stoinis gets down on one knee and swipes at it, squirting it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
shortish outside off. Shreyas loads up and scuffs it down the ground towards long off
back of a length on leg. Stoinis stays back and pushes it into the mid wicket region
back of a length on the stumps. Shreyas bunts it perfectly between deep mid wicket and deep square leg, and hares back for two
shorter and wider outside off. Stoinis does well to reach it but cannot do much with it otherwise. Punched to sweeper cover
back of a length outside off. Jabbed out towards extra cover
back of a length on middle and leg. Shreyas goes back and tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket
flighted up full outside off. Stoinis stretches forward and drives it towards long off
back of a length on middle and off. Shreyas goes back and pokes it into the mid wicket region

another wild swish, and Prabh bites the dust too! Punja had PBKS on a leash, and he now has another reward! A little slower outside off and he seems to hold the length back too, perhaps anticipating the charge. Prabh goes after it anyway but loses all control and shape. Slices it a mile up and extra cover settles under it to send the half-centurion on his way!
back of a length, following the batter outside leg. Shreyas stays further leg side and cuts it towards deep point
and change of fortunes for the PBKS skipper too! Short on middle and leg. Sits up and Shreyas, rocking back, belts it over deep mid wicket!
short and wide. Prabh reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep point
dragged down outside off. Shreyas winds up for the big hit but clinks it off the bottom half of the bat towards long on
pulls the length back outside off. Prabh skips down the track and slaps it towards long off
fired in full on middle and off. Prabh cannot get under it and scuffs it towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Shreyas hangs back and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
zipped in full on off. Prabh continues swinging like a rusty gate and chunks it off the inside edge towards deep mid wicket
off-pace again and bashed in short. Prabh hares down and drags it into the leg side towards deep mid wicket
slower bumper outside off and this holds in the surface. Prabh is way too early into his swipe and misses the ball by a fair distance
full toss, top edged and Prabh somehow survives! Juicy full toss on middle stump. Prabh has a massive mow at it and shanks it badly. Punja runs back from short fine but cannot quite get there
slanted in full on the pads. Prabh works it towards deep backward square leg
shortish on the hips. Shreyas gets inside the line and tugs it towards deep backward square leg
more runs! Back of a length outside off and this straightens. Shreyas wafts at it and misses, and Jurel gets nutmegged too. Bonus runs for PBKS!
back of a length outside off. Prabh goes back and pushes it to deep mid wicket. Yet another fifty for this youngster - and this has come off 35 balls!
shortish outside off. Shreyas throws his hands at it and cuts it towards backward point, who fumbles and allows a single
back of a length on off. Prabh goes back and knocks it to long on
leg-cutter on a back of a length on the pads. Prabh tucks it into the mid wicket region and keeps strike
angled in full on middle and off. Flicked down the ground to long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran gets squared up and the ball rolls off the leading edge into the off side
much more in control, and much more authoritative! Zipped in full on leg. Prabh skips down the track and slams it over mid off!

another edge, and Archer has a wry smile on his face! The only solace is that he may now have gotten used to it. Back of a length outside off. Prabh swings at it wildly and gets a top edge that hurtles over the keeper!
banged in short on off. Prabh jumps up onto his toes and dabs it towards backward point
fired in full on middle and off. Prabh presses forward and knocks it to long off. Just seven off the over, and that is tidy work by Jadeja
on a length on middle and off. Shreyas steps out to the leg side and drives it on the up towards long off
shortish again and offering a hint of width. Shreyas gives himself more room and slaps it towards sweeper cover
pushed in on a length on the pads. Prabh helps it behind square and keeps things ticking
fullish just outside off. Shreyas gives himself just enough room and punches it towards long off
tossed up full outside off. Shreyas gets forward and pokes it towards extra cover
helped away! Fired in full outside leg and Prabh makes the most of it. He gets down on one knee and lifts it over short fine leg!
angled in full on the pads. Shreyas tucks it behind square and gets off the mark
flighted up full outside off. Shreyas gets onto the front foot and pushes it towards extra cover

big, big lbw shout, not given! RR review! Googly on a length on middle and off. Shreyas does not read it out of the hand and looks to play it off the pitch. The ball rips back in, beats the bat and raps him on the back leg. Oh, looks like the ball has hit the front leg first. This might be sliding down. Ball Tracking comes up and says the ball would have been sneaking down leg. Shreyas stays!

another shank, and this time, Connolly has to go! Floated up full outside off and this looks like the googly. Connolly tries to go downtown but slices across it a little too much. Gets more height than distance and Ferreira, stood at long off, takes it smartly over his head. Another sprightly cameo by Connolly, but from an RR POV, they have broken a threatening partnership!
back of a length on middle and leg. Prabh lets the ball come to him before working it towards deep mid wicket
right in the gap! Fired across the batter on a back of a length wide outside off. Connolly throws his hands at it and slices it between backward point and short third!
another clean strike! Marginally short just outside off and that is all Connolly needs. He stands tall and thumps it over long on!
fired in full outside off. Prabh presses forward and knocks it to long off
back of a length on the stumps. Prabh dinks it into the mid wicket region and calls for two. Jadeja tears after it, hits the stumps at the bowler's end, but Connolly makes it back
back of a length on the pads. Connolly waits for it and punches it towards long on
back of a length on middle and leg. Eased out to deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Connolly looks to force it through the off side but only swishes at thin air
shortish again, on the stumps. Prabh hops back and pulls it powerfully towards deep mid wicket
googly on a back of a length outside off. Punched off the back foot towards sweeper cover
no problems with this - this is out of the screws! Dragged down outside off. Connolly rocks back and pummels it over deep mid wicket!

skied a mile up, and Connolly has enough on it to clear Archer! Googly on a back of a length outside off. Stops a little and Connolly miscues his swipe. Goes a mile up, but Connolly has enough juice on it to get it beyond long on!
fullish on middle and off. Prabh comes forward and turns it behind square
up avd over! Right in the slot on off, and Connolly takes full toll. He goes through the line and pops it over mid off!
full outside leg. Prabh gives himself plenty of room but scuffs his drive. Mid off does well to dive to his right and save three
on a length on middle and off. Prabh gets onto the front foot and prods it towards mid off
back of a length on off. Connolly stays leg side of the ball and punches it towards mid off
very full on leg. Prabh pokes it into the wide mid on region and ambles across to the other end
serious whippage, and Prabh goes all the way! Fullish on the pads, and this is there to be hit. Prabh uses his wrists to perfection and whips it over deep backward square leg!
into the blockhole on middle and off. Prabh jams down on it and digs it out towards long on. First over in the innings without a boundary
fullish on the stumps. Connolly has another stab at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
full and sliding down leg. Connolly is late on the stroke and misses, but he does get the wide call
slower bumper on off and this takes three business days to arrive. Connolly has a hack at it and jams it off the inside edge into his thigh pad
fullish outside off. Connolly gets onto the front foot and pushes it to mid off
slower ball on a fullish length on middle and leg. Prabh comes forward and bunts it enough to mid wicket's left
full outside off. Prabh gets onto the front foot and drives it towards mid off
low full toss on middle and off. Prabh tips it to mid off and saunters across to the other end
this has been thumped! A bit of a half-tracker and Prabh is all over it like a rash. Rocks back and hammers it over mid wicket!
dispatched, and with utter disdain! Back of a length on the stumps. Prabh clears his front leg, swings his bat like an axe and pummels it back past Burger!
back of a length just outside leg. Prabh, shimmying around, stabs at it, and chunks it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
just over! Back of a length on middle and leg. Prabh gets his front foot out of the way and muscles a swipe beyond mid on. Parag chases after it and reins it in
back of a length on middle and off. Prabh gets up on his toes and pats it back to the bowler
back of a length in the channel. Connolly happy to watch it go through to the keeper

clothed to mid on, and Arya has fallen to Archer! What a passage of play, and Archer has come up trump! Full ball just outside off, bowled at a tick over 150kph. Arya tries to take Archer downtown but ends up getting it all wrong. Tame chip off the inner half of the blade and Burger does the rest. Archer's face is like stone, but he knows he has worked this youngster over and now sent him back to the shed!

oh my - more luck for Arya, and you can sense the steam coming out of Archer's ears now! This is a proper snorter. On a back of a length on middle and this climbs through to Arya. He has to take evasive action and the ball floats off the outside edge, bursting through the fingers of short third!

full and sliding down leg. Arya looks to help it fine but is late on the stroke. Grazes the pad and gets gathered by Jurel to his right. Bat nowhere near the ball. Impact was off the pad. Looks like this call has been reviewed. Replays came up much earlier, which showed the ball grazing the pad. Seems like it was a PBKS review - in which case, it was an incredibly poor review.
hard length on middle and leg, and this rears up. Arya hops up onto his toes and fends it into the off side

nicked and more luck for Arya! You make your own luck, they say. Arya's pyrotechnics have meant there is no slip in place. Squares Arya up with this back of a length ball in the channel, and the outside edge is thick enough to hurtle to Jurel's left!
length outside off. Arya comes forward and pushes it towards point, who dives over it and allows Arya to keep strike
edged and four! Arya all over Burger! Fullish outside off, inviting the drive away from the body. Arya goes after it but the outside edge flies to short third's right!
wow - this is some stroke! Back of a length outside off. Arya gets up on his toes again and off the back foot, cracks it over point. One bounce and into the fence!

goodness me - this boy can play! Back of a length outside off and this is all class. Arya rises with the bounce and creams it on the up over extra cover. Bowled 140.8kph. Arya made it feel it was much slower!
Arya not holding back! He never does! Shortish just outside off. Arya stands up on his toes and muscles it through mid wicket!
safe! Banged in short on off, and this climbs through. Arya cannot free his arms and splices it into the vacant mid wicket region
back of a length, shaping into the pads. Prabhsimran hops around his crease before glancing it straight to short fine leg
full and slanting into leg stump. Prabhsimran opens up his stance and swings at it with abandon. Misses it and the ball nearly rolls off his pad into the stumps
back of a length on middle and this nips back in sharply. Bowled at 142.4kph and Prabhsimran, rushed on the stroke, gets cut in half. Rapped on the back thigh
four more! Not off the bat, but PBKS will take it. Back of a length and swinging down leg. The ball clips the thigh pad and rattles away past the keeper!
over the top, and PBKS are underway! It took all of one ball. Prabhsimran latches onto this short and wide delivery, and crashes it over point!
hard length on middle and leg. Prabh jumps around his crease before dropping it into the on side with soft hands

Ferreira with a fitting finish, and the streak is over! A tremendous knock under pressure, and the Punjab Kings have been subjected to their first loss of the season! Full toss on the stumps and that sums up how PBKS' night has gone. A little too easy for Ferrreira and he accepts that gift with glee, clubbing it over mid on and sealing the deal. A fist bump or two from the South African. RR's middle order, under fire for most of this tournament, has come to the party, and they decided to turn up against the table-toppers!
scooped a mile up, but it falls in front of deep point running in! Short and wide. Dubey checks his shot and nearly gets dismissed. Miscues it enough to survive
on a length outside off. Dubey pokes it out towards sweeper cover and he is content to keep strike via a single
slower ball on a shortish length outside off. Ferreira fetches it and flat-bats it towards deep mid wicket
streaky, but RR will not care one bit! Sharp short ball just outside off and this hurries onto Ferreira. He has a hack at it and the ball soars off the top edge past short third!
off-pace, dug in and angled across the batter outside off. Ferreira swishes at it with every sinew in his body but still cannot make contact
this is crazy hitting, and this is a monster hit! Banged half-way down and Ferreira says thank you very much. He stands up tall and clatters it a mile over deep mid wicket. A 105m six!

that has sped to the fence! Some power! Mid off did well to not get a hand to it in the end. Slot ball outside off and Ferreira bludgeons it to mid off's right. Shreyas snapped down to his right but it was too hot to handle!
up, up and away! This is a proper half-tracker. Quite wide too and Dubey fetches it from outside the line to dump it over deep mid wicket!
slower bumper outside off. Dubey has a long, hard look at it before letting it go. Wants the wide too but the umpire is having none of it
low full toss on middle and off. Ferreira bends his back knee and tugs it towards deep mid wicket
a good comeback by PBKS' spearhead. Right into the blockhole, and this is just inside the tramlines on the off side. Ferreira chalks it into the off side
thumped past Arshdeep! Full toss outside off. Ferreira loads up and then thunders it over the bowler's head. Arshdeep missing his mark; Ferreira isn't!
fetch that from beyond the sightscreen, says Ferreira! Length ball outside off and that is just what Ferreira needs. He plants his front foot and smokes it over the bowler's head!
slower ball on a back of a length on the pads. Dubey tucks it between deep mid wicket and deep square leg, and saunters back for two
clever, clever batting! Yorker speared into the pads. Dubey gets his bat down in time and somehow manages to nutmeg himself while flicking this to the long leg fence!
dug in half-way down outside off. Ferreira gets on up on his toes and hacks it to deep mid wicket
slower ball on a back of a length just outside off. Ferreira has an agricultural mow at it and only swats away a few flies
full toss outside off and Ferreira has another fresh-air shot. Tries to hit it too hard and in the end, makes no contact whatsoever
this is very wide. Well beyond the tramlines and some more exercise for the umpire
begins his new spell with a vicious dipping yorker outside off. Ferreira too early into his swing and misses it
back of a length outside off. Ferreira hangs back and jabs it into the off side

nicely done, even if it will not go for four. Yorker on middle and off. Dubey opens his bat face and steers it between backward point and short third. Stoinis gives chase and pulls it back in, and RR get into an awful muddle. Both batters looking at the ball and thinking the ball is going to the fence, and they only run a single...
short and wide outside off. Dubey lets it go and gets the wide call
another stunning blow! Slot ball just outside off. Dubey plants his front foot and goes through the line, blasting it over the bowler's head!
pick the bones out of that! Back of a length outside off. Dubey spots the length, clears his front leg and clubs it a mile over deep mid wicket. A 98m six!
into the blockhole on middle and leg. Ferreira cannot get under it and clinks it out to long on
off-pace and into the track outside off. Dubey has a wild swipe at it and chunks it off the inside edge into the on side
four more! This is not great bowling. Full ball down leg and with short fine leg in position, Ferreira only has to glance it past that fielder. Beats him to his left and collects another boundary!
banged in short outside off. Dube reaches out for it and swats it towards deep square leg
off the mark instantly! Full and drifting into the pads. Dubey uses the pace and tickles it into the fine leg fence. Chahal tumbled to his left but it was in vain!
full and wide outside off. Ferreira throws the kitchen sink at it and powers it towards sweeper cover

off the toe-end but hey, they all count! Full toss outside off. Ferreira swings at it with all his might and the ball pings off the bottom of the bat. Bounces into the turf, and bounces well over the keeper eventually!
short and wide outside off. Ferreira reaches out for it and slaps it straight to extra cover

clothed to deep mid wicket, and Parag has thrown it away! Chahal dangles the carrot, and Parag bites, to his and RR's detriment. Looks to mow it over cow corner but does not have enough room to swing his arms freely. Bat closes upon impact too and Parag could not have picked out Shedge better, even if he tried. Huge, huge moment in the game!
back of a length on off. Ferreira hops back and knocks it to long off
length on middle and leg. Parag lets the ball come to him before turning it towards deep mid wicket
very full just outside off. Parag jams down on it and the ball nearly dribbles onto the stumps
superb batting! Slower and fuller on middle and off. Parag brings out the reverse, waits on it and then thrashes it between backward point and short third!
Parag is making this his stage tonight! Shortish on middle and leg. Sits up and Parag opens up his stance to demolish it over deep mid wicket!
very full on the pads. Parag tucks it towards deep backward square leg
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Ferreira swishes and misses. The keeper fumbles too and ends up conceding a bye
through the gap! Not entirely in control, but Ferreira will not mind one bit. Short, wide and he scythes it between backward point and short third!
slower ball on a full length outside off. Parag has to reach out in front and pats it into the mid wicket region
banged in short just outside leg and this climbs through steeply. Parag looks for the upper-cut but is beaten by the bounce and perhaps the lack of pace
shortish just outside off. Ferreira gets up on his toes and punches it towards long on
pushed in on a length on the pads. Parag bunts it into the mid wicket region and with Chahal tasked to chase after it, both batters have the necessary time to get back
fizzed in very full just outside leg. Ferreira advances and drills it towards long on
angled in full on the pads. Parag lunges forward and dinks it into the on side. Uh-oh, looks like Chahal has overstepped. Not what PBKS wanted...
length on middle and leg. Parag places it enough to long on's right and dashes back for the second
googly on a back of a length on off. Ferreira hops back and hacks it to long on

Jaiswal perishes too, and Chahal is turning this game around! Floated up full outside off and Jaiswal cannot resist the temptation to have a pop at it. He swings at it with all his might but cuts across it far too much. Goes straight up and long off does the rest. PBKS with another vital and timely breakthrough!
googly on a back of a length wide outside off. Left alone and called a wide
splits the field perfectly! Low full toss on middle and leg, but the full toss trick does not work for Chahal this time. Jaiswal rolls his wrists and whips it between long on and deep mid wicket!
zinged in on a length on middle and off. Parag plays it back to the bowler
audacious, and outrageous! Pushed in full on middle and off. Parag unfurls the reverse and nails it flat over backward point. Carries all the way!
jammed in full on the pads. Jaiswal eases it out into the on side
slowed up and bowled wide on a length outside off. Jaiswal throws his hands at it but drills it straight to extra cover
darted in on a length just outside off. Parag pushes it to long off
shortish outside off, angling across from around the wicket. Jaiswal slaps it towards sweeper cover
the skipper is off the mark! Tossed up full on the stumps. Parag gets down on the sweep and heaves it enough to long leg's left!
flighted up full on middle and leg. Parag stretches forward and defends

oh dear, what have you done, Dhruv Jurel?! This is a juicy and gentle full toss on the stumps. Jurel should have hit it all the way back to Jaipur but instead, he shanks it terribly. Only gets height on it and long on accepts the offering with utmost glee. Jurel is hanging around, hoping this could be a No ball, but don't think that is happening. This is an umpire review, just to be clear. First replay seems to suggest the ball is well below the waist. Jurel feels so too and starts trudging off the moment he sees it on the giant screen. Waist measured at 1.03m and the ball is passing at 0.67m at the popping crease. Jurel has to go!
short and wide outside off. Jaiswal goes back and across before chopping it towards deep point
shortish and on the pads. Jurel swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg
on a length on middle and leg. Jurel takes a step down the track before patting it towards the bowler

sloppy on the fence! Hung up on a length wide outside off. Jaiswal lays into it and razes it past extra cover. Wadhera puts in the dive on the fence but the ball squirms under his body to hit the cushion!
fullish on middle and leg. Jurel comes onto the front foot and knocks it to long off
fired in on a back of a length outside off. Jurel laces his cut but cannot get it past backward point
shorter and wider, but Brar is bowling to the plan. Jaiswal slaps it towards sweeper cover
shortish on the stumps. Jurel gives himself a bit of room and hacks it to long on
shortish outside off. Jaiswal stays back and punches it towards sweeper cover
very full on leg. Jaiswal flicks it down the ground to long on
slower on a length outside off. Jurel slices it towards short third, who misfields and ends up conceding a single
back of a length on middle. Jurel stays leg side of the ball and cuts it off the stumps towards backward point
slider on a length on middle and leg. Jaiswal hangs back and punches it to long on
back of a length on the pads. Jurel lets the ball come to him before working it towards deep backward square leg
googly on a fullish length on the pads. Eased out to deep mid wicket
pushed in full on the pads. Jaiswal tucks it towards deep mid wicket
darted in full and wide. Jaiswal reaches out and drives it past extra cover. Back for a couple of runs
hung up on a length outside off. Jurel gives himself room and drills it towards sweeper cover
fired in full on middle and leg. Jaiswal gets onto the front foot and knocks it to long on
back of a length, angling into the pads. Jurel stabs it towards deep mid wicket and keeps things ticking
shortish on off. Jurel backs away and chops it towards backward point
too short, too wide, and too easy! Jaiswal sits back, gets on top of the bounce and then flays it over point!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Jurel dabs it towards deep backward point
oh, hello! Jurel is here to play too! Fractionally short outside off and that is all Jurel needs. He gets his front hip out of the way and thunders it flat over the deep mid wicket fence!
full toss outside off. Jurel throws his hands at it and drills it towards cover
full ball on the pads. Jaiswal tucks it towards deep backward square leg
no respite for Ferguson just yet! Well, he does not help himself here. Dishes out a full toss on the pads and gets clipped through square leg!
back of a length on middle and off. Jurel hops back and cuts it towards backward point. First over without a boundary this innings
darted in on a length on off. Jaiswal clears his front leg and hacks it to long on
fired in full just outside off. Jaiswal winds up but scuffs it towards mid off
back of a length on the stumps. Jurel goes back and stabs it enough to mid on's right for a single
slower and perhaps shorter, angling into the body. Jurel looks for the pick-up pull and misses. Pinged on the thigh
back of a length on middle and off. Jurel stays back and chops it towards short third
four, six and four to end the over! Half-volley on the pads and that is too easy for Jaiswal. He snaps his wrists into action and clips it past mid on!
Jaiswal is the protagonist now! Back of a length outside off. Jaiswal picks the length early, stands tall and bulldozes it over mid off!
Jaiswal continues on his merry way! In the slot on middle and off. Jaiswal plants his front foot, goes through the line and bangs it over the bowler's head!
back of a length outside off. Jurel hangs back and runs it down to deep backward point

low full toss, and Sooryavanshi has plinked this a mile up. Taken by mid off running back, and Arshdeep rips this game wide open! Not the best ball Arshdeep will ever bowl. But he will take. And PBKS will of course take it too. A touch outside off, which makes Sooryavanshi fetch it, given the angle from around the wicket. Slices it and Shreyas, back-pedaling, snares the chance. Another tone-setting knock, and this is the window of opportunity PBKS would have been after!
bring out the chopper! Missed yorker and this ends up being a slot ball on the pads. Sooryavanshi whips through it and helicopters it over wide long on!
yorker but the line is not quite on point. Slides down leg and called a wide once Sooryavanshi misses it
low full toss, following the batter outside leg. Sooryavanshi clinks it down to long on
zipped in full on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi a tad late on his flick this time and the ball pings off the pad towards short third
going, going, and gone! Slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi reads it very, very early and wallops it over deep mid wicket!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Sooryavanshi waits on it before dabbing it towards backward point
back of a length outside off. Jaiswal gets up on his toes and punches it neatly towards deep backward point
short, wide and put away again! Jaiswal this time, and that should get him up and running too. Not quite off the middle but enough sauce to beat cover point to his right!
banged down the ground! The boy's a star and a phenomenon! Slower ball on a back of a length on middle and leg. Sooryavanshi picks it, waits for it and clobbers it over mid on!
my word - this is a ridiculous shot! Slot ball on the pads, bowled at 145.2kph. Probably went much quicker. Serious whippage and Sooryavanshi dumps it over the deep mid wicket fence!
off the top edge, and over Jansen at slip! Dug in short just outside off. Sooryavanshi swings for the hills and the ball flies off the top edge beyond the tallest man on the field!
short and zipping through outside off. Sooryavanshi thinks about the cut for a brief moment before bailing out of the stroke
length ball on the pads. Sooryavanshi presses half forward and pushes it towards mid wicket
length outside off. Jaiswal punches it on the up towards cover point, where Arshdeep fumbles and concedes a single
short, wide and punished! Does this boy have no fear?! Sits up nicely and Sooryavanshi has the room to get his fast hands through. Slaps it through cover, and that is 15 off the opening over!

four more! Length on middle and off and this shapes away. Does not matter to Sooryavanshi, though, as he plants his front foot and muscles it towards deep square. Not the greatest effort on the fence by Shedge, and he lets in four!
Sooryavanshi has had enough of the defending! Full and sliding into the pads. An in-swinger gone wrong and Sooryavanshi whips it over deep backward square leg!
another brilliant out-swinging yorker, finishing on off. Sooryavanshi jams down on it and keeps it out
very full on middle and off, and this curves away late. Sooryavanshi lets the ball arrive before patting it gently into the off side
on a length outside off and shaping away. Jaiswal goes chasing after it and drives it uppishly towards deep backward point
